subject: [RFC PATCH 34/57] mm/collapse: implement MADV_COLLAPSE in madvise.c

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch moves the implementation of MADV_COLLAPSE from khugepaged.c to madvise.c, where it belongs among other madvise operations. The move simplifies the code and removes unnecessary dependencies between the daemon's file and the syscall implementation. The patch also updates the declaration in huge_mm.h and adjusts the eligibility test for collapse. The changes do not affect the functionality of MADV_COLLAPSE itself.
